extDescription.message: Click an image on X (Twitter) to open a viewer with original quality, vertical stitching, and the author's whole thread in order. Unofficial.

tip_equal.message: Equal width: scale every image to the base width

tip_scale.message: Same scale: apply one scale to all images, set so the first image gets the base width (size differences are kept)

tip_best.message: Auto: fit width for tall images, fit the screen for wide ones. Never enlarged beyond original size

hint.message: Click: next image / Shift+click: previous / 1–6: view mode / Ctrl+wheel: zoom / Esc: close

opt_start_desc.message: The view mode used when the viewer opens. "Last used mode" starts with the mode you last picked in the viewer.

opt_ratio_desc.message: Share of the screen width. In Equal every image gets this width; in Scale the first image gets this width and all images use the same scale.
